description.value: Hard braking detected by the on-board accelerometer while on a bike lane; no fall and no injury reported.

source.value: Synthetic example (MDS trip, event and telemetry data is sensitive location data, so no real feed is used). Fictitious provider, vehicle, trip and incident identifiers (UUIDv5, not in the MDS providers.csv registry); positions are approximate points in downtown Louisville, KY, matching the Louisville municipal-boundary Geography example of the MDS repository. Structure: Mobility Data Specification 2.1.0, CC BY 4.0, Open Mobility Foundation.
